inputs.text: [excited] He was 2 meters 20 long — as long as a motorcycle! 0 point 75 meters tall — [gently] it would come up to your waist! And 80 kilos — as heavy as Dad! [amazed] Scientists think he could run about 16 miles an hour — as fast as a bike going fast.
[confident] Compact and tough. A really muscular little dinosaur.
